name: Blotto game
summary: Two-player constant-sum game of simultaneous resource distribution across battlefields to win a majority.
rules_text: Each player has a fixed total resource budget R. There are K battlefields of equal value. Simultaneously, each player divides his budget into K non-negative numbers that sum to R, one per battlefield. After both allocations are revealed, each battlefield is compared: the player who allocated more to that battlefield wins it, ties are draws. The player who wins more battlefields wins the game; payoff is number of battlefields won. No further rounds.
rating_reason: Simultaneous resource distribution over battlefields, perfect hidden allocation strategy.
